title: Merrill's Marauders Congressional Gold Medal Act
official_summary:
Merrill's Marauders Congressional Gold Medal Act

This bill directs Congress to award a Congressional Gold Medal to the 5307th Composite Unit (Provisional), commonly known as Merrill's Marauders, in recognition of their bravery and outstanding service in the jungles of Burma (Myanmar) during World War II.

Following its award, the gold medal shall be given to the Smithsonian Institution, where it shall be displayed and made available for research.

summary.headline: A 2020 law directs Congress to award a Congressional Gold Medal to Merrill's Marauders, a World War II unit that served in Burma.
summary.what_it_does: The law honors the 5307th Composite Unit (Provisional), known as Merrill's Marauders, for its service in the jungles of Burma (now Myanmar) during World War II. After the medal is awarded, it is to be given to the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian will display it and make it available for research.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on October 17, 2020.
